Team.title: Team
Team.description: Everyone in {name}, their role and the tools they use. Invite people and change their access here.
Team.readOnly: Everyone in {name} and the tools they use. Only the owner and admins can invite people or change access.
Team.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.
Team.emptyBody: Invite your colleagues so they can use the workspace's tools.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can make someone an admin.

roleWhat.admin: {name} will be able to invite people and change their access, but not billing.
roleWhat.member: {name} will use the tools they have access to and won't manage the team.
roleWhat.guest: {name} will see only what's shared with them.

impact.invitedPaid: Once they accept, they take a paid seat.
impact.invitedGuest: Once they accept, they won't take a paid seat.
impact.addsSeatCost: Adds a paid seat: {before} → {after} seats, {cost} more on the per-user lines.
impact.withdraw: The invitation sent to {email} stops working. You can invite them again later.
impact.remove: {name} loses access to {workspace} and all its tools straight away.
impact.guestNoSeat: Guests don't take a seat, so the price doesn't change.

seats.title: Seats
seats.modelA: Each active member or admin is one seat, and that one seat count applies to every tool billed per user, whatever tools they use. Guests are free. An invitation takes a seat once it's accepted.
seats.modelB: Each tool billed per user counts only the people who have access to it. Guests are free. An invitation takes a seat once it's accepted.
seats.linesNote: Prices per billing period, before tax.
seats.noLines: No tool is billed per seat right now, so adding people doesn't change the price.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.body: They get an email to join {name}. You see what it costs before you send.
invite.adminOwnerOnly: Only the owner can make someone an admin.
invite.roleAdmin: Invites people and changes their access. No billing.
invite.roleMember: Uses the tools you give them access to.
invite.roleGuest: Sees only what's shared with them. Free.
invite.sentGuest: Guests are free: the seats don't change.
invite.sentSeats: When they accept, the workspace counts {seats} paid seats.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can make someone an admin. Choose another role, or ask the owner.
errors.taken: This person is already in the workspace or invited.
errors.email: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
errors.tools: Choose at least one tool, or give access to all tools.

access.label: Tool access
access.allHint: Every tool the workspace has, including ones added later.

accessDialog.title: Tool access for {name}
accessDialog.body: Choose which of the workspace's tools they can open.
accessDialog.impactGuest: Guests are free, so seats don't change.
accessDialog.impactSame: Seats don't change: one seat count applies to every tool billed per user.
accessDialog.impactMore: {count, plural, one {Adds a seat on # tool billed per user.} other {Adds a seat on # tools billed per user.}}
accessDialog.impactFewer: {count, plural, one {Frees a seat on # tool billed per user.} other {Frees a seat on # tools billed per user.}}
accessDialog.errorEmpty: Choose at least one tool, or give access to all tools.

cost.guestBody: Guests don't take a paid seat.
cost.title: Adds a paid seat when they accept: {before} → {after} seats
cost.linesIntro: Each tool billed per user goes up by one seat:
cost.when: Only once they accept. Prices before tax.
cost.noLines: No tool is billed per seat right now, so the price doesn't change.
